name: install a pinned miniconda distribution and create a conda environment with a specific python version
definition: Install a specific miniconda build and create a conda env whose default python interpreter is the requested version.
failure_mode: Wrong conda version or the environment's python version does not match, failing version checks.

name: install a pinned-level hadoop distribution and a matching java runtime
definition: place a specific hadoop 3.3.6 tree under the expected prefix and install a java major-minor 11 runtime so both tools report the correct versions.
failure_mode: wrong java major or wrong hadoop release fails the version checks.
